services.name: Summer Conservatory
services.desc: Do you love theatre and outdoor adventures? Each summer, the Whidbey Island Center for the Arts (WICA) Youth Summer Conservatory introduces Whidbey Island youth to the magic of theatre. This adventure camp is filled with acting and the great outdoors. Youth ages 10-14 gain first-hand experience in costume and set design, music and lighting, and the performing arts. Each day includes games, exploring, imagination, and a fun-filled lunchtime. The first part of the camp will be spent at WICA, discovering all the secrets of the backstage experience, learning a script, and rehearsing a play.
